acceptance_proved: Completed and >1 MiB verified-prefix staging survives producer interruption, reaches the actual named resume branches, retains its inode and receives validation on full bytes.
Zero-exit error receipts reject resumed/reused/external/merged candidates under require, with nonpublication, removal of rejected stages, fresh validated retries and unchanged-sync no-ops.
Actual external copy and fingerprint-hint reuse candidates reach the common receiver gate independently of DNG semantic eligibility.

Both merge receivers use their own local pinned helper; first rejection prevents second invocation; second rejection preserves its old live bytes after first commit; recovery remains a conflict and regenerates/validates both exact candidates.
Require and warn timeouts reap the child before the CLI returns; actual client-receiver SIGINT rejects under both policies, reaps its child and preserves old live bytes.
At two CPU permits and one filesystem execution credit, six actual directory validation helpers have observed peak overlap exactly one on each compiler.
limitations: No actual Adobe SDK invocation, photographic input, Lightroom operation, preview build, catalog/cache access or mounted Photo-volume operation occurred.
This does not prove Adobe parsing/decode/raw-digest behavior, real-corpus validation, SDK parallelism, memory/performance or Lightroom UI Validate parity.
Hint-copy reuse is deliberately distinct from rename-only moves, which remain outside received validation scope.
Cancellation qualifies active client-side receiving execution; forwarding client-only SIGINT to a remote receiving server is not established here.
Existing configured external merges are tested; automatic XMP semantic merge and cross-replica atomic publication remain separate.
Filesystem keys are cooperative st_dev job groups; physical disk identity, RSS/descriptor caps and crash-durable publication are not established by these tests.
